description: List open (resting) spot orders. Omit coinId for ALL open orders across coins, or pass one to filter. Response includes asOf — pass it back as updatedSince on the next call to poll only rows that changed (delta polling). Paper trading only (virtual mUSD). Fills follow paper_execution_v1 with a disclosed execution cost; see executionModel in quote/trade results.

agentTrace.description: Optional private trace metadata stored in the caller's ledger.

decisionId.description: Agent decision id for quote/write attribution.

rationaleSummary.description: Optional concise rationale summary. Do not include chain-of-thought, secrets, or account identity.

strategyLabel.description: Short strategy label, self-reported by the caller.

coinId.description: Coin UCID filter. Omit to list ALL open orders.

updatedSince.description: ISO 8601 cursor: only orders whose row changed since this instant. Pass the previous response's asOf back here.

name: list_open_orders
title: List open spot orders
